description: MRP to tenge / МРП в тенге / АЕК теңгеге. Converts between MRP (monthly calculation index, АЕК/МРП) and tenge using the 2026 MRP value. Use it for fines, fees, benefits and tax thresholds that the law states in MRP.

amount.description: Amount to convert, in the unit given by "unit".

lang.description: Language of source titles, limitation notes and page links: "ru" (Russian) or "kk" (Kazakh). Default "ru".

unit.description: "mrp": amount is a number of MRP, result is tenge. "kzt": amount is tenge, result is MRP.

name: kz_mrp_convert
title: Convert MRP to tenge and back (2026)
